name: Verify fulfiller can override AI-generated classifications
objective: Validate that fulfillers can modify the Category and Subcategory that were auto-populated by the AI.
precondition: A ticket exists with AI-populated Category and Subcategory. Fulfiller has edit permissions.

steps.description: Open a ticket that was created by Agentforce with AI-populated classification
steps.expectedResult: Ticket record opens showing AI-generated Category and Subcategory
Category field is editable and accepts the new value
Subcategory field is editable and accepts the new value
The overridden classifications are saved successfully
